newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - IBP Inc cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - IBP Inc cut to hold.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell analyst Timothy Ramey said Friday he lowered his rating on meat processor IBP Inc to hold from buy.
-- Earlier, IBP reported second quarter earnings of $0.36 a share down from $0.90 a year ago and below the Deutsche Morgan estimate of $0.50 a share.
-- "IBP's gross margin was 4.3 percent, well below the six percent earned last year, but sequentially better than the 3.3 percent earned in the (first quarter)," Ramey said in a report.
-- Ramey said his preliminary estimate for 1997 is $1.40, down from $2.25 a share previously, and for 1998 is $1.80, down from $3.20 previously.
-- He added that an IBP conference call with analysts "may necessitate fine tuning" of the estimates.
